extraction.notes: No qualifying summer camp program or 2027 camp announcement could be verified on the public official pages. The Classes page describes year-round performing arts instruction; its direct fetch returned no readable text, although official search results supplied class descriptions. The Junior Hub is password protected. Historical blog references confirm past summer camps but do not identify a current 2026 or 2027 offering. Public junior-production listings provide shows rather than verifiable summer camp enrollment details. No cards were created from these incomplete references.
